CompleteText: The muster is complete. Warriors stand ready to answer the call.
Well done. Select a Worker and right-click a tree to gather - resources are the foundation of every strategy.
Your population cap just grew. Pick House from the build menu, then click the ground to place one.
A growing population means a growing kingdom - train Workers from your Town Center.
Patience paid off. Not every victory comes from rushing forward.
The structure falls. Select a military unit, then right-click an enemy building to attack it.
